item.description:
A new look for cards and popovers, and drag-and-drop between the calendar and the sidebar.
- **One card for tasks in the same slot.** Tasks booked into the same time show as a single card with a count and a segmented bar. Click it to see them side by side, reorder them, or drag one out onto its own time. - **Liquid Glass popovers.** Every popover is now the same rounded glass card, without the pointer tip. - **Drag a sidebar project onto the calendar** to block out time for it. The new block shows up right away, in Today if it's booked for today. - **Drag a block onto a sidebar project** to file it there. - **Calendar blocks are more solid**, and all-day events sit inset at the top of the day. - **Notes and links edit in place.** In a task's card, click "Add notes" or "Add link" and start typing. Return starts a new line in notes; click anywhere else to finish.
Fixes
- A task's title is editable on the first click. - A task card grows to fit its notes instead of cropping its top and bottom. - The insertion line when reordering a card's tasks is no longer cut off.

Calendar and planning improvements.
- **Block personal events automatically.** Turn it on in **Settings › Planning** and upcoming personal events are blocked on your work calendar without a right-click. Events you unblock by hand stay unblocked. - **Tasks in the same block share one card.** Each task gets its own row, which you can drag or open on its own. Rows that don't fit fold into a **+N** list. - **Overlapping blocks stack like Calendar.** When a later block leaves the earlier one's title visible, it's drawn on top, indented, instead of squeezed into its own column. - **Drag a project's Today heading onto the calendar** from Triage to block out time for it. Hold Shift to fill the block with the project's unscheduled Today tasks. - **See where an unscheduled task went.** Dragging a block off the calendar now highlights the project it went back to in the sidebar. - **A little celebration** when you tick off a task.
Fixes
- "Block time on" and "Block personal events on" now group calendars by account, so two calendars with the same name can be told apart. - A sub-task's link icon in a block's popup highlights on hover and no longer also opens the sub-task. - The outline around a dragged project heading is now evenly spaced.

Maintenance release.
- No changes to planning; this release confirms updates install cleanly.
